title: MAGAZINE BAR, RESERVE NUMBER, G KEYCAP
why: His answer of 2026-10-13: bar for magazine, number for reserve additional rounds. Build 6b of 8. Every gun key now shows its magazine as a small fill bar along the foot of the key (light above half, amber down to a quarter, red below) and the rounds he carries in reserve as the number, where it used to print the rounds in the magazine. The half-grey and full-grey states are unchanged, the Undercroft belt shows the bar alone (it has no reserve), and a gun with no magazine keeps its old look. The throwable key that G throws wears a small G keycap, following U. The hover card of a grenade, a heal and an armour plate names the key of its class: G THROW, H HEAL, HOLD H PLATE. Drawing only.
now: Gun keys now show the magazine as a bar and the reserve as the number; the G key shows on the throwable it throws.
